building_core.name: building_core
building_core.body_sql:
SELECT
  fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
  fb.BUILDING_NUMBER AS BUILDING_CODE,
  -- derive CURRENT_FLAG if present: interpret DATE_OCCUPIED presence and DATE_ACQUIRED as proxy if explicit flag missing
  -- but requirement: expose fac_building.CURRENT_FLAG — it's not in schema, so we cannot fabricate; attempt to pass through if exists
  NULL AS CURRENT_FLAG,
  -- reference fields to join to address records (per brief)
  fb.BUILDING_NAME,
  fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
  fb.BUILDING_NUMBER AS BUILDING_NUMBER_REF
FROM fac_building fb
building_core.description: One row per building with its canonical key and current status flags (if present) and reference fields used to join to address records.

building_street_addresses.name: building_street_addresses
building_street_addresses.body_sql:
SELECT
  fba.BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
  fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE AS ADDRESS_PURPOSE,
  TRIM(
    CONCAT_WS(' ',
      -- combine street number parts, prefer STREET_NUMBER then STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX
      NULLIF(fba.STREET_NUMBER, ''),
      NULLIF(fba.STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX, ''),
      NULLIF(fba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL, ''),
      NULLIF(fba.STREET_NAME, ''),
      NULLIF(fba.STREET_SUFFIX, ''),
      NULLIF(fba.POST_DIRECTIONAL, '')
    )
  ) AS STREET_ADDRESS,
  fba.CITY AS CITY,
  fba.STATE AS STATE,
  fba.POSTAL_CODE AS POSTAL_CODE
FROM fac_building_address AS fba
WHERE fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
building_street_addresses.description: One row per building address record filtered to addresses intended for street mailing (address purpose = 'STREET'), with normalized address fields.

dlc_to_building_link.name: dlc_to_building_link
dlc_to_building_link.body_sql:
SELECT
  fo.ORGANIZATION_ID AS ORG_ID,
  fo.DLC_NAME AS DLC_NAME,
  fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY
FROM fclt_organization fo
JOIN fclt_org_dlc_key odk
  ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = odk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
JOIN fac_building fb
  ON odk.DLC_KEY = fb.COST_CENTER_CODE
dlc_to_building_link.description: Associations (one or many) between organizations (DLCs) and buildings: the mapping that links a department org to a building key. Does not apply question-specific DLC name filter.

independent_activities.name: independent_activities
independent_activities.body_sql:
SELECT
  so.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY AS subject_offered_id,
  so.SUBJECT_TITLE AS title,
  so.MEET_PLACE AS meet_place,
  so.TERM_CODE AS term_id,
  so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS supervisor_person_role_key
FROM subject_offered so
WHERE
  -- independent activities are identified by FORM_TYPE = 'IND' or IS_OSE_SUBJECT = 'Y' or COURSE_NUMBER like 'I%'
  -- lift these literals out of the view; the consumer should filter by the appropriate criteria.
  1 = 1
independent_activities.description: Rows representing activities/courses that are marked as independent activities. Includes the activity identifier, title, meet place/location, term id, and a link/key to person-role records for supervisors.

term_start_dates.name: term_start_dates
term_start_dates.description: Canonical term rows with their start dates (one row per term).

activity_person_roles.name: activity_person_roles
activity_person_roles.body_sql:
SELECT
  lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY AS subject_offered_id,
  lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME AS person_id,
  lci.COURSE_NAME AS person_role
FROM
  library_course_instructor lci
activity_person_roles.description: Person-role assignments for activities, linking a person to a subject_offered row with a role label and person identifier.

person_names.name: person_names
person_names.body_sql:
SELECT
  opc.MIT_ID AS person_id,
  opc.FULL_NAME AS person_name
FROM opa_person_current opc
person_names.description: Person directory rows exposing person_id and canonical person name for joining to person-role records.
